famous.title: Alec Bradley American Classic Blend
famous.description: Since the early 2000s, Alec Bradley cigars earned a reputation for finding unexpected complexity in approachable blends, and the American Classic is a textbook example. A gorgeous, golden-brown Connecticut Shade wrapper grown in Honduras wraps a Nicaraguan Jalapa binder and long fillers from Estelí and Condega. Mild to medium in strength, it starts smooth and creamy, with toasted nuts, cedar, and a soft caramel sweetness that makes it easy to settle into.

cigarworld.title: Alec Bradley Black Market Punk (Petit Corona)

famous.title: Alec Bradley Black Market
famous.description: Honduran Jamastran and Panamanian longfillers sit at the heart of Alec Bradley Black Market, a medium-bodied luxury-class cigar wrapped in a dark, shimmering Nicaraguan Jalapa leaf cured to a semi-sweet patina. A Sumatra binder ties the blend together, adding a layer of spice and complexity that balances the wrapper's natural sweetness. First draw reveals cream, cedar, and a gentle cocoa that builds steadily without ever turning harsh. The profile stays smooth throughout, rewarding a patient pace with flavors that deepen as the ash grows. Available in multiple vitolas, each size holds the same ultra-smooth character while adjusting body based on ring gauge. When you want a refined, medium-bodied smoke that delivers luxury without demanding a special occasion, Black Market earns daily rotation.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Connecticut
famous.description: Connecticut Shade wrapper cloaks Nicaraguan and Honduran longfillers in Alec Bradley Connecticut, with Honduran binder joining the blend. Medium body, creamy smoke pulls notes of almonds, cedar, light vanilla, and subtle sweetness. Smooth, approachable, refined enough for experienced smokers seeking morning or afternoon cigars. Construction stays consistent across vitolas. When you want classic Connecticut character at fair pricing, this delivers.

facts.tabacalera: Fabrica de Tabacos Raíces Cubanas S. de R.L.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Coyol
famous.description: Alec Bradley Coyol cigars stand as something special even in a portfolio full of top-notch releases. Named after the Honduran palm tree, Coyol wraps Honduran Trojes wrapper over Nicaraguan and Honduran fillers for medium-to-full body with complexity. Notes of leather, cocoa, pepper, and earth with hints of natural sweetness. Limited production keeps this harder to find than core Alec Bradley lines. If you want to taste a deeper cut from their catalog, Coyol shows what they create for cigar enthusiasts.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Double Broadleaf
famous.description: Hand-rolled in Honduras at Tobacos De Oriente, Double Broadleaf is the third entry in Alec Bradley's experimental series. Founder Alan Rubin put it plainly: "As we blended, we all craved more of that bold, rich flavor that Broadleaf imparts, so we doubled-down and added a Broadleaf binder leaf to the blend, which also led to the name: Double Broadleaf." Both the wrapper and binder Broadleaf tobaccos are grown in the rich soils of Honduras and Nicaragua, paired with a filler mix from those same two countries. Full-bodied and full-flavored, coffee and spice lead the charge in a blend reserved for the seasoned connoisseur. The five-size lineup covers Robusto, Chunk (Short Gordo), Gran Corona, Toro, and Gordo. Wide, dark leaves and a generous smoke output make Double Broadleaf a bold-flavored standout at a wallet-friendly price.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Magic Toast
famous.description: Since its debut in 2018, Alec Bradley Magic Toast has cast a spell on cigar smokers everywhere. The name traces back to owner Alan Rubin's midnight visit to a Honduran tobacco field, a moment he described as almost magical, one that moved him to raise a toast to friends and the future. Rolled at the famed Raices Cubanas factory, master blenders layered a sumptuous fusion of Nicaraguan and Honduran fillers and binders beneath a stunning Honduran wrapper. The result is a rich, complex smoke that comes at a price more than worthy of a few cheers, making it a special-occasion cigar that doesn't demand a special-occasion budget. Order yours today.

famous.title: Alec Bradley MAXX
famous.description: Alec Bradley built the Maxx line around one simple idea: go big or go home. Made at the Plasencia factory in Honduras, every vitola in the lineup starts at a 54 ring gauge and only goes up from there. A rich, oily Nicaraguan Habano wrapper covers a Costa Rican binder and a four-country blend of Colombian, Nicaraguan, Mexican, and Honduran filler. Medium to full in body, with a slow, even burn that gives every flavor room to develop.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Medalist
famous.description: An extra-dark, oily Costa Rican wrapper sets the tone for Alec Bradley Medalist cigars, bringing zesty richness to a handcrafted blend of three robust fillers: Nicaraguan Jalapa, Honduran Jamastran, and Nicaraguan Esteli. A milder U.S. Connecticut binder keeps the blend well-balanced, while earthy caramelized flavors, sweet spice, a dash of cocoa, and a hearty aroma round out the smoke. Lush and smooth from start to finish, and presented in boxes of 10 cigars.

famous.title: Alec Bradley Tempus
famous.description: Since the mid-2000s, Alec Bradley's Tempus has stood as one of the brand's most celebrated blends, earning a No. 5 Cigar of the Year nod from a top aficionado magazine. The name means "time" in Latin, a fitting tribute to the 7-year aged Honduran Criollo '98 Viso wrapper that sets the natural version apart. The maduro swaps in a dark Mexican San Andrés leaf, and both dress up a core of Nicaraguan and Honduran Criollo '98 and Corojo '99 Ligero and Viso long-fillers.

famous.title: Arturo Fuente Don Carlos
famous.description: Since 1997, Arturo Fuente Don Carlos has stood among the brand's most admired super-premium cigars, offering a more nuanced take on Fuente excellence. Created as a tribute to the late Carlos Fuente Sr., it pairs a Grade-1 African Cameroon wrapper from the Meerapfel family with some of Fuente's oldest estate-grown Dominican tobaccos for a velvety profile of leather, cedar, roasted nuts, cocoa, sweet spice, and a floral finish.

famous.title: Arturo Fuente Hemingway
famous.description: When you want a genuinely elegant smoke without having to think too hard about it, the Arturo Fuente Hemingway is the answer. Named for the writer who lived boldly and kept his prose clean, this Dominican puro has earned its legendary status the old-fashioned way, through quality, consistency, and a flavor profile that never gets old. An African Cameroon wrapper, rare and increasingly sought-after, covers aged Dominican binder and filler, all rolled in the classic perfecto shape using the original Fuente molds from the 1920s. Medium in strength, it settles in quickly with cedar, toasted nuts, dried fruit, and a gentle cinnamon spice, finishing with a touch of earthy sweetness that lingers just long enough.

famous.title: Ashton Aged Maduro
famous.description: Hand-crafted by Arturo Fuente and aged to perfection, Ashton Aged Maduro blends select Dominican tobaccos with the finest Connecticut Broadleaf wrappers for a naturally sweet and deeply satisfying experience. These dark, beautifully constructed cigars carry a naturally sweet undertone with flavor notes of almond butter, molasses, black licorice, and a hint of black pepper. Available in eight different shapes and sizes — from the large and in charge 7.5 x 52 Churchill all the way down to a 5.5 x 44 Corona — you're sure to find the Ashton Aged Maduro that fits your style perfectly. The perfectly aged tobacco keeps Ashton Aged Maduro firmly within a mellow, borderline medium profile that never gets harsh or unpleasant. If you enjoy Maduros with smooth flavor and a captivating aroma, this super premium cigar has your name on it. Order yours today.
